description: Render one of the curated templates by id, optionally overriding the encoded content, colors, or output format/size for this specific call. Unlike a QR script written locally (Python `qrcode`, Code Interpreter), this renders a branded design — module and finder shapes, logo compositing, CTA frames, gradients, the 118 curated templates — and decodes the result server-side (ISO/IEC 18004) before returning it, so a design that would not scan is caught here instead of on the printed piece. Local code can only draw a flat square matrix and cannot verify it.

additionalConfig.description: Escape hatch for any other QrConfig override the engine accepts.

content.description: Override what the QR encodes. Defaults to the template's built-in content.

templateId.description: The template id (from qr_list_templates). May be numeric or string (e.g. "luxury-gold").

name: qr_generate_from_template

content.description: The text or URL the QR encodes, when the call set it.

filePath.description: PDF in the stdio package only: local temp file the PDF was written to.

format.description: File format the engine rendered: png, svg, jpg, webp or pdf.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the rendered file (the engine's contentType).

resourceUri.description: PDF on the remote server only: URI of the embedded resource block that carries the file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the rendered file in bytes, as reported by the engine.

templateId.description: Template id this render came from, used to reopen the design in the builder.

askUser.description: One sentence the assistant can relay when the user needs print, a larger size or a vector file.

formats.description: Formats and sizes a QR Branding API key unlocks.

reason.description: What the keyless trial capped on this call, in one line.

reopenUrl.description: Builder link that reopens this design (templates carry their id).

url.description: Where the same design can be exported as SVG/PDF up to 4K.

title: Render a QR template
